# InvestingNoobs

> InvestingNoobs is a free, beginner-friendly website for understanding crypto, stocks, commodities and trading risk. It combines a live market tracker with a 50-lesson practical course in plain English.

## Primary pages

- [Live market tracker](https://investingnoobs.com/): crypto, stock and commodity prices with search and watchlist tools.
- [Crypto & investing course](https://investingnoobs.com/blog.html): 50 guided lessons from foundations to DeFi, prop firms, risk and long-term habits.
- [Final assessment](https://investingnoobs.com/test.html): a 50-question educational assessment covering the course.
- [About InvestingNoobs](https://investingnoobs.com/about.html): project purpose and market-data sources.

## Course topics

The course explains cryptocurrency, Bitcoin, Ethereum, wallets, exchanges, stablecoins, blockchain, DeFi, smart contracts, liquidity pools, stocks, commodities, inflation, market capitalisation, volatility, fees, portfolio construction, technical and fundamental analysis, prop firms, leverage, drawdown, trading psychology, scams, taxes and long-term investing routines.

## Editorial principles

Content is educational, beginner-friendly and risk-aware. It does not provide personalised financial, legal or tax advice. Market data can be delayed or unavailable and should be checked against an authoritative provider before making a decision.
